## ROOT PROBLEM DIAGNOSIS

**Why user must repeat prompts:**
1. **Written ≠ Executed** — Rules existed in files but were not followed in behavior
2. **No enforcement mechanism** — Until QA agent runs on every output, rules drift
3. **Stage 1 never ran** — Builder jumped to solving without confirming understanding
4. **Token tracking structural gap** — Tool calls block text output, causing tracking to be deferred then forgotten

**Solution already implemented:**
- Prime SOP Stage 7.5 (proactive error prevention)
- QA Agent (10-check enforcement on every output)
- Stage 1 relay-back (now being executed)
- Pre-send check log line requirement
